sloka: प्रवृद्ध इव मातङ्गः कक्ष्यया बध्यमानया ।उपरिष्टाच्छरीरेण छायया चावगाढया ।सागरे मारुताविष्टा नौरिवासीत्तदा कपिः ॥५-१-६७॥
transliteration: pravṛddha iva mātaṅgaḥ kakṣyayā badhyamānayā ।upariṣṭāccharīreṇa chāyayā cāvagāḍhayā ।sāgare mārutāviṣṭā naurivāsīttadā kapiḥ ॥5-1-67॥

translations.english: When the vanara was flying in the sky, his shadow reflected in the ocean looked like a ship driven by the wind and sailing on the sea below (as if the lower part of his body was under water and upper part occupied the sky)
